2.0.0.Title: Extraterrestrial Factility
2.0.0.Description: Some kind of underground facility with advanced technology, large machines and extraterrestrial organisms.
Discovery and Initial Analysis: An accident occured during an experiment involving [REDACTED] which caused several researchers and workers to vanish out of thin air.
What happend to all of them is still not known, but one of them miraculously returned 7 days later when they reappeared inside a cave 6 miles south of Site-117.
Upon [REDACTED]'s return to the site, she explained that she was teleported to another site or facility that was far more advanced than anything she's ever seen before.
She described that she saw a large white and black creature 9 floors tall that looked like a humanoid with eyes all over it that was looking down on her.
The creature had some kind of halo with spikes floating above its head and a crown below.
She later described that creature was hooked up to large pillars twice the size of the creature, that were connected to the creature's torso through tubes and cables.

What really scared her though was that before she could even process what she was seeing, an echoing voice ringed through her head saying "This is not your place." before a flash of green blinded her and she found herself in the cave.
Investigation: After [REDACTED]'s insistance that her body did not make up false memories out of shock to fill in the missed time, it was decided to use [REDACTED] to detect any abnormalities in her condition.
The testing showed that there were foreign energies never encountered before lingering inside her constitution, indicating that what she was claiming could be a possibility.
Through the combination of [REDACTED] and [REDACTED] we were able to both view and validate the authenticity of the memories of miss [REDACTED].
Theories: There is a possibility that the other workers involved in *Incident-19x082* was transported to the same dimension and have yet to be caught and transported back.
The possibility that they already were transported back but died before contacting the foundation is also highly possible since they could have been crushed
inside a wall upon their return, or even gotten lost or stuck deep inside a crevice with no way out.
Another possiblity is that they died in the incident and were never transported at all, or that they were transported to another dimension entirely and haven't
Conclusion: Miss [REDACTED] experienced a leap of time and dimension, and was transporeted back by a higher lifeform after appearing in another dimension she did not belong in.
Through calculations it was determined that the reason she appeared in a cave south of Site-117 was because she was returned to the same coordinates, not location.
Meaning that because our planet is constantly moving, she was returned the position relative to the dimension that she was at 7 days prior to her return,
which is different from the position relative to the planet. Why it took her a total of 6 days, 23 hours and 59 minutes to transport there and back is still not known,
but may be looked into in a future where we've developed time related technology and have the possiblity of making the necessary calculations to determine such things.
